title: Output relabeling preserves computation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f : \\{-1,1\\}^n \\to \\{\\pm1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree that queries coordinates of inputs in $\\{\\pm1\\}^n$ and outputs signs. If $T$ computes $f$, then the tree obtained by replacing each leaf sign with its corresponding real value computes the real-valued function obtained by viewing each value of $f$ as a real number.
hypotheses_covered: target is a Boolean function from length-n sign vectors to signs
T is a finite decision tree with sign-valued queries and sign-valued outputs
